scope: Keep the causal content and physical calculations; show the spoken current trace and make the full phone player fit.

cues.title: 记录同一次放电
cues.caption: 电流逐渐减小，电容器两端电压同时降低。
cues.captionEn: Current declines as the capacitor voltage falls.
cues.zh: 看已经充电的电容器。开关闭合，电荷经过传感器和电阻流动，传感器留下电流随时间变化的曲线。开始时电压较高，电流较大。随着电荷减少，电压降低，电流也逐渐变小。曲线尾部趋近零，但有限时间后仍有少量电荷留下。
cues.en: Watch the charged capacitor. When the switch closes, charge passes through the sensor and resistor, producing a current-time record. Initial voltage and current are high. As charge decreases, voltage falls and current declines. The tail approaches zero, but some charge remains at every finite time.

cues.title: 把面积加起来
cues.caption: 面积给出已释放电荷。
cues.zh: 重新看同一次放电，这次关注曲线下面的阴影。一个很短的时间内，电流乘以时间就是流过的电荷。把所有小面积相加，得到已经放出的电荷量。下面同时保留剩余电荷的读数，两部分合起来，才是开始时储存的总量。
cues.en: Replay the discharge and watch the shaded area. Over a short interval, current times time gives transferred charge. Adding the small areas gives the charge already released. The remaining-charge reading stays visible too. Released and remaining portions together make the initial total.

cues.title: 接到相同的空电容器
cues.caption: 达到共同电压后，电荷与电压都各减半。
cues.captionEn: At a common voltage, each has half the original charge and voltage.
cues.zh: 换一种方法观察电荷与电压。A 原先带电，B 是相同的空电容器。闭合连接开关，电荷重新分配，直到两端电压相同。再断开连接，A 和 B 各得到一半电荷，电压也都是原来的一半。电荷守恒，但连接过程中会损失一部分电场能。
cues.en: Now compare charge and voltage another way. A is charged and B is an identical empty capacitor. Close the switch and charge redistributes until their voltages match. Disconnect them: each retains half the original charge and half the voltage. Charge is conserved, but some field energy is lost during connection.

cues.title: 再换一只新的空电容器
cues.caption: B 保留自己的电荷，A 接到新 C 后再次减半。
cues.captionEn: B retains its share; connecting A to a new C halves A again.
cues.zh: 把上一只 B 移走，它仍然保留自己的电荷。现在拿来一只新的空电容器 C，接到同一只 A 上。达到共同电压后再断开，A 的电荷与电压又减半。关键是每次接入的电容器都相同，而且原先没有充电，不能把已经带电的 B 当作新的空电容器。
cues.en: Remove the previous B; it still holds its share. Bring in a new empty capacitor C and connect it to the same A. After they reach a common voltage, disconnect them. A’s charge and voltage halve again. Each receiving capacitor must be identical and initially uncharged; the already charged B is not a fresh empty capacitor.

question.zh: 不数电子，怎样知道流过多少电荷？
question.en: How can current reveal how much charge has passed?

lead.zh: 先看同一次放电的电流，再把短时间内流过的小份电荷累加起来。
lead.en: Watch the current from one discharge, then add the small amounts of charge that pass in short intervals.

principle.zh: 电流表示单位时间流过的电荷；I–t曲线下面积给出已释放电荷，有限时刻还有电荷留在电容器中。
principle.en: Current is charge per unit time. The area under an I–t curve gives released charge; some charge remains at every finite time.

question.zh: 初始电压和电容相同，电阻加倍，初始电流与最终可释放的总电荷怎样变化？
question.en: With the same initial voltage and capacitance, what changes when resistance doubles: initial current or total available charge?

explanation.zh: 初始电流U₀/R减半，RC时间常数加倍。初始电荷CU₀不变，所以放电时间趋于无穷时可释放的总电荷相同；在相同的有限时间内，较大电阻释放得较少。
explanation.en: Initial current U₀/R halves and the RC time constant doubles. Initial charge CU₀ stays the same, so the total released as time tends to infinity is unchanged. At the same finite time, the larger resistor releases less.

question.zh: 接上相同的空电容器，电压为什么减半？
question.en: Why does an identical empty capacitor halve the voltage?

lead.zh: 跟住A和第一次接收电荷的B，再把A接到新的空电容器C上。
lead.en: Track A and its first receiver B, then connect A to a new empty capacitor C.

principle.zh: 相同电容器连接后达到相同电压；在总电荷守恒且接收电容器初始不带电时，各分得一半电荷和原电压。
principle.en: Identical connected capacitors reach the same voltage. With total charge conserved and the receiver initially empty, each retains half the original charge and voltage.

question.zh: 第一次分电后，把仍带电的B再次接回A，A还会减半吗？
question.en: After the first sharing, reconnect the still-charged B to A. Does A halve again?

explanation.zh: 不会。此时A和B都是3V，两者没有电势差，理想模型中不发生新的净电荷转移。再次减半的条件是换入相同且初始不带电的C，不能把B原有的电荷抹掉。
explanation.en: No. A and B are both at3V, so there is no potential difference and no new net charge transfer in this ideal model. Halving again requires an identical, initially uncharged C; B’s stored charge cannot be erased.

sourceQualification: Textbook P40 discharges B before reuse. Illustration uses a distinct identical empty C, preserving the same initial condition while making removed B accounting visible.6V/1mF/2kΩ are ideal teaching values, not textbook measured samples.
